items.t: Said civic engagement is important and that everyone plays a part in ensuring elections are secure, transparent, and fair.
items.q: Whether registering to vote for the first time or keeping their voter registration information up to date, civic engagement is important. We all play a part in ensuring our elections are secure, transparent, and fair.

record.t: Announced that 17,872 West Virginians had registered to vote since the May 12, 2026, Primary Election, bringing the state to 1,210,297 registered voters.
record.q: WV Secretary of State Kris Warner announced today that 17,872 West Virginians have registered to vote since the May 12, 2026, Primary Election. The state now has 1,210,297 registered voters.

record.t: Was appointed to a second term as National Co-Chair of the NASS Elections Committee, serving until July 2027.
record.q: WV Secretary of State Kris Warner has been appointed to serve as National Co-Chair of the NASS Elections Committee for a second term.

record.office: Secretary of State of West Virginia
record.t: Took office as West Virginia's 31st Secretary of State on January 13.
record.q: Secretary Warner took office as West Virginia's 31st Secretary of State on January 13 after serving four years as the Executive Director of the WV Economic Development Authority (WVEDA).

record.t: Was elected West Virginia's 31st Secretary of State.
record.q: Kris Warner was elected West Virginia’s 31st Secretary of State on November 5, 2024.

record.office: Executive Director, West Virginia Economic Development Authority
record.t: Served as Executive Director of the West Virginia Economic Development Authority after being appointed by Governor Jim Justice.
record.q: In 2021, Governor Jim Justice appointed Kris to serve as the Executive Director of the West Virginia Economic Development Authority.

record.office: West Virginia State Director, USDA Rural Development
record.t: Served as West Virginia State Director for USDA Rural Development after being appointed by President Donald J. Trump.
record.q: Secretary Warner's expertise was called upon in 2017 when he was appointed by President Donald J. Trump to serve as the West Virginia State Director for USDA Rural Development.

record.t: Reported that 68,235 voters changed party affiliation since Jan. 31, 2024.
record.q: West Virginia Secretary of State Kris Warner reported that 68,235 voters have changed party affiliation since Jan. 31, 2024

record.t: Said that canvassing across the state will include a manual audit of the unofficial results, with teams of opposite parties hand-counting paper ballots from at least 3% of each county's precincts.
record.q: canvassing across the State will include a manual audit of the unofficial results. Each county will employ teams of opposite parties to manually count every paper ballot from at least 3% of the county's precincts
